correctness.rationale: The proof handles the normalization by 1/d and identifies the a.e. convex-gauge radial derivative, proves local uniform convergence by dominated convergence plus uniform translation Lipschitzness, changes variables with the valid nonsmooth radial area formula, and obtains tightness from power means and the exact chord formula. For polytopes, finite spherical bands around facet ties have O(1/p) measure, giving O(1/p) local error; positive radial derivative of the strictly convex limiting functional transfers this to Hausdorff rate. The independent rectangle/triangle checker validates finite-p normalizations and quantitative trend, but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: It resolves the natural boundary-regularity gap between the existing smooth-body critical transition and basic polytopes, extending the limit to every convex body. The facet-switch argument gives an effective asymptotic rate for all polytopes rather than a single toy example. The precise geometric limit and quantitative stability for a broad nonsmooth class are useful in affine convex geometry and covariogram analysis.
